claim: All 18 ib_paper closed rows graded MEASURED via exit_price_source=ib_execution carry pnl exactly 0.0 although their own entry/exit/size imply about -$115k, so a could-not-look realizedPNL is stored and graded as a measured break-even.
evidence: GET /api/diag/journal?table=trades&limit=1000&offset=0..6000&envelope=true (n=6286 rows, total_rows=6286), then src.runtime.provenance.classify_pnl over status='closed' AND pnl NOT NULL: rows with why='exit_price_source=ib_execution' -> n=18, Counter({0.0: 18}), all account ib_paper (MGC 13, MES 5), closed 2026-07-31..2026-09-27. Example id 6170 MGC long sl_cross entry 4292.7 exit 4267.246 size 90 pnl 0.0 notes.ib_execution=0.0. Implied gross with multiplier MGC 10 / MES 5 (notes.contract_value_usd when present, else assumed): -115353.31.
expected: realized_pnl_from_raw returns None (not measured) when the venue figure is absent (exchange_fills_ib.py:321-339), so an unreported figure grades UNVERIFIED, and a measured pnl is not 0.0 on 18 of 18 stop-outs.
actual: pnl 0.0 with notes.ib_execution=0.0 is accepted as the broker figure; classify_pnl grades the row MEASURED because it keys on exit_price_source only. ib_paper therefore shows 18 'measured' rows summing to $0.00 and 0 non-zero measured rows.
population: ib_paper closed rows with pnl NOT NULL, n=51; of these 18 ib_execution rows, 18/18 are 0.0. Implied-pnl figure rests on an assumed multiplier and is an estimate, not a measurement.
detector: None today. Add a provenance self-test: a row with exit_price_source=ib_execution and pnl==0 while |exit-entry|*size > 0 must classify UNVERIFIED. The provenance-consumer-guard checks writers/readers of keys, not value plausibility.
proposed_fix: Root cause not established (candidates: ib_insync CommissionReport.realizedPNL defaults to 0.0 before the report arrives; or the matched fills include the opening fill). Trace with scripts/pull_ib_executions.py raw store. Then in src/runtime/provenance.py::classify_pnl demote ib_execution rows whose pnl==0 with non-zero price move, and in src/runtime/exchange_fills_ib.py treat a 0.0 realized_pnl on a closing fill with a non-zero move as None.

claim: /api/bot/stats paper.totalPnLMeasured (+94,618.28) is not a measured figure: it sums MEASURED and ESTIMATED rows, and one ESTIMATED ib_paper row (id 4773, +249,185.00) is 2.6x the whole figure; over the same rows the MEASURED-only sum is negative.
evidence: curl https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/stats -> paper:{totalPnL:52184.57,pnlCoverage:0.2761,pnlMeasuredCount:367,pnlEstimatedCount:699,totalPnLMeasured:94618.28}. Row 4773 (diag journal): ib_paper MGC long entry 4364.6 exit 4626.9 size 95 pnl 249185.0 exit_reason tp_cross, notes exit_price_source=recorded_exit_price pnl_source=local_compute cost_source=estimate. My reclassification of paper closed rows (n=1470, account_class=paper): measured -51061.52, estimated +152249.69 (-96935.31 without row 4773).
expected: A field named Measured sums only rows graded MEASURED, or the field name and its count say ESTIMATED is included; paper.pnlMeasuredCount (367) is the denominator of the sum.
actual: Count is MEASURED-only (367) while the sum covers 367+699=1066 rows; the sum's sign is set by a single ESTIMATED local_compute row. performance.py:629 pnl_is_measured=bucket in (MEASURED, ESTIMATED) is deliberate and commented (performance.py:810-825), but the name and the paired count disagree.
population: /api/bot/stats paper block at 2026-09-29 ~09:55Z: 1066 rows (367 measured + 699 estimated). My independent reclassification used 1470 paper closed rows, because the API applies its own exclusion predicates; the two populations differ and I did not reconcile them.
detector: None. A test asserting total*Measured equals the sum over MEASURED rows only, or that a key named *Measured has a count over the same population, would catch it.
proposed_fix: src/web/api/routers/performance.py + dashboard.py: publish totalPnlMeasuredOnly (MEASURED rows, same population as pnlMeasuredCount) and rename or annotate totalPnlMeasured as measured_plus_estimated; add pnlEstimatedSum. Consumers below switch after the rename. Separately review row 4773 (95 MGC contracts).

claim: scripts/ops/r4_demotion_gate.py and research_results_gate.py key on totalPnlMeasured (MEASURED+ESTIMATED) while the coverage floor and the record field pnl_coverage_measured count MEASURED only, so the committed evidence record's net_usd_measured comes from a wider population than its own coverage figure.
evidence: grep -n 'totalPnlMeasured' scripts/ops/r4_demotion_gate.py:210 (net_usd_measured), src/runtime/research_results_gate.py:90; live GET /api/bot/performance perStrategy (real-money, 15 strategies): eth_pullback_2h trades 15, pnlMeasuredCount 10, pnlEstimatedCount 5, pnlCoverage 0.6667, totalPnlMeasured -15.4898; trend_donchian_eth_4h 11 rows, 6 measured, 5 estimated, coverage 0.5455; xrp_pullback_2h 14, 8 measured, 4 estimated, coverage 0.5714.
expected: An evidence record used by an armed auto-land mandate states how many of the rows behind net_usd_measured are ESTIMATED, or excludes them.
actual: For eth_pullback_2h one third of the rows behind net_usd_measured are ESTIMATED and coverage 0.6667 clears the 0.6 floor. The record does not carry the estimated count.
population: Real-money perStrategy block, 15 strategies, 442 trades, 2026-09-29. I did not run the gate; I read its field mapping only.
detector: None on the mapping. A gate self-test with a fixture of MEASURED plus ESTIMATED rows of opposite sign would fail it.
proposed_fix: scripts/ops/r4_demotion_gate.py: write n_estimated and net_usd_measured_only into the record; judgment: gate on the MEASURED-only sum or keep MEASURED+ESTIMATED with an explicit rule. Gate logic is Tier 2/3, so the operator decides.

claim: 16 bybit_1 rows graded MEASURED via exchange_fill (all closed 2026-07-24..30) carry a locally computed pnl that disagrees with their own entry/exit/size by more than 1% of notional plus $1; 10 of them have the opposite sign, including 5 sl/tp closes with the wrong-sign pnl.
evidence: Journal pull as above; for rows status=closed, pnl NOT NULL, exit_price NOT NULL, not ib/options: implied=(exit-entry)*size*dir; divergent if |pnl-implied|>0.01*entry*size+1. bybit_1 exchange_fill n=195 divergent=16 signflip=10 sum(pnl of flips)=-3510.89. Examples: id 4212 SOLUSDT long 72.98->72.79 x600.1 exit_reason sl pnl +588.10 implied -114.02; id 4053 XRPUSDT long tp pnl -2250.22 implied +769.43; id 4218 AVAXUSDT long pnl +834.91 implied -922.79. Divergent per closing date: 07-24 1/1, 07-25 2/3, 07-27 6/7, 07-29 6/8, 07-30 1/1, and 0 divergent among the rows closed 2026-07-15..17 and 2026-08-24..09-29.
expected: pnl_source=local_compute from an exchange_fill exit price reproduces (exit-entry)*size within fees.
actual: classify_pnl grades the exit-price SOURCE, not the arithmetic (provenance.py documents SOURCE not OWNER), so wrong-sign pnl is labelled measured in /api/bot/trades/closed pnlProvenance and in perStrategy sums for bybit_1 (paper).
population: bybit_1 exchange_fill rows n=195 (paper account). Gross implied pnl; fees excluded, hence the 1% tolerance. Not checked whether netting explains any of the 16.
detector: None; the contained window suggests the underlying writer was fixed about 2026-07-30 but no guard would catch a recurrence. Proposed: a check in classify_pnl or scripts/ci that grades pnl UNVERIFIED when sign contradicts the row's own price move beyond fees.
proposed_fix: Add the sign-consistency gate (the same one FIX-CA-19 added to backfill_orphan_pnl._plan_row) to classify_pnl as a demotion to UNVERIFIED; optionally mark_netted_duplicate_pnl-style one-off correction of the 16 rows (Tier 2, DB writeback).

claim: 34 of 114 bybit_1 rows graded MEASURED via bybit_closed_pnl diverge from their own entry/exit/size by more than 1% of notional plus $1, largest id 2329 BTCUSDT pnl +4678.12 vs implied +1463.47.
evidence: Same journal pull and test as the previous finding: ('bybit_1','bybit_closed_pnl') n=114 divergent=34 signflip=1 (id 2568, -127.71 vs implied +316.98); ('bybit_2','bybit_closed_pnl') n=222 divergent=16 signflip=2 (ids 1287, 1453, both under $1); bybit_2 rebuild n=131 and backfill n=2 divergent=0.
expected: A broker closed-pnl value belongs to the row it is stored on.
actual: Likely netting: one closed-pnl record covers several journal rows (WORKPLAN-2026-08-21 G.1 documents 1.31-1.44 fill/trade ratios on bybit_1). I did not verify netting per row, so this may be MEASURED-but-not-owned, which provenance.py states it does not grade.
population: bybit_1 n=114, bybit_2 n=222, status closed, pnl and exit_price non-null. Gross arithmetic, tolerance 1%+$1.
detector: None for ownership. provenance-consumer-guard covers key writers and readers, not per-row ownership.
proposed_fix: judgment: add a per-row ownership flag (measured_owned true/false) from the netting attribution store, or state on the dashboard that bybit_closed_pnl on a netted account is account-level truth. No change to src in this audit.

claim: Three-state (could-not-look) fields in production code are absent from check_collapsed_states.py CONTRACTS, including broker_truth.read_state, which drives journalTrust on every trades and performance read, and prop open_risk_state and day_pnl_state.
evidence: python3 -c import CONTRACTS -> 52 contracts. grep -c on scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py for: broker_truth 0, query_state 0, positions_state 0, wallet_state 0, open_risk_state 0, day_pnl_state 0, verify_state 0, total_rows_state 0, balance_state 0. Producers: src/runtime/broker_truth.py:218-235 (read|absent|unreadable); src/prop/prop_reconcile.py:648,690; src/prop/prop_risk_gate.py:271-294; src/prop/prop_fills_staleness.py:406,631 (balance_state insufficient_snapshots|read_failed); src/units/accounts/ib_client.py:3240-3291 (verify_state verified|unverified|not_attempted); src/web/api/routers/diag.py:1299 (total_rows_state count_failed). Probe validity: the same grep finds registered names, e.g. ib_venue_session, bybit_available.
expected: Every field that encodes could-not-look vs looked-and-found-none has a CONTRACTS row, so a consumer that collapses it fails CI (CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL: a state nothing branches on is already collapsed).
actual: Unregistered. For broker_truth the consumer branches correctly today (journal_trust_for, broker_truth.py:264-275, sends absent and unreadable to TRUST_UNREADABLE). For the prop, IB and balance fields I established the producers only, not the consumers.
population: 102 distinct *_state/*_basis/*_status literal keys emitted in src/**/*.py by grep; about 80 not in CONTRACTS after name match. I classified about 15 as plausibly three-state; the rest I did not read, so the true gap is unknown.
detector: The guard has no discovery step: it checks only what is registered. Proposed: a self-scan that lists emitted *_state keys with no CONTRACTS row and no allow-list entry, reported by run_guards.py.
proposed_fix: scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py: add CONTRACTS rows for broker_truth.read_state, prop_reconcile.open_risk_state, prop_reconcile.day_pnl_state, ib_client.verify_state, prop_fills_staleness.balance_state, diag total_rows_state; add the discovery scan. Run the guard afterwards: it fails where a consumer does not branch.

evidence: sed -n 245,260p .claude/skills/performance-review/SKILL.md: 'win_rate (closed_filled rows where pnl > 0 / closed_filled rows)', 'pnl_total, pnl_avg_per_trade'. grep -rn 'pnlProvenance\|pnlCoverage' .claude/skills -> 0 hits. grep -n -i 'provenance\|coverage' comms/schema/performance_review_response.template.json -> 0 hits (the same grep finds 'coverage' in ml_review_response.template.json:53, so the probe can hit). ml-review SKILL.md:223 'realized: win-rate / PnL of closed trades this model scored' also has none. expected: Each pnl aggregate a review emits states the measured share (pnlCoverage) or is computed over MEASURED rows.
